exact_lineage.rule: Accept target lineage only from an exact returned National LIDAR or Time Stamped feature intersecting the native EPSG:27700 target geometry; a service registry, tile name, dataset summary or nearby feature is not sufficient.

ea_accuracy_scope.rule: EA plus/minus 15cm RMSE and relative/random-error specifications are survey/dataset quality controls and must not be converted into parcel-specific confidence or uncertainty without target-specific ground truth.

ea_groundtruth_scope.rule: Ground Truth points independently validate survey accuracy; do not assign their plus/minus 3cm point accuracy directly to a parcel elevation result.

wcs_numeric_route.rule: Use the persistent EA Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 route for actual raw elevation pixels. WMS imagery, service summaries and symbology statistics are not numeric target evidence.

terrain50_pixel_centre.rule: OS Terrain 50 ASCII grid heights are sampled at documented 50m pixel centres only; do not use a tile corner or arbitrary nearest-coordinate interpretation.

terrain50_tile_metadata.rule: Require the actual Metadata_<tile>.xml for TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27 and read EPSG:27700, EPSG:5701/ODN and earliest/latest flying dates from that tile metadata before secondary crosscheck promotion.

hmlr_native_geometry.rule: Keep HMLR exact point-in-polygon and raster masks in native British National Grid/EPSG:27700 because web reprojection may shift some features by up to 15m.

transport_fail_closed.rule: Web safe-open blocking, runtime DNS failure, XML-client limitations or missing receipts are transport/runtime failures; they are not NO_DATA and cannot close a target as absent.

numeric_claim.rule: No parcel elevation, quartile, range, height difference, accuracy, confidence or uncertainty may be written until exact lineage, HMLR geometry, actual EA raster bytes and actual OS Terrain 50 archive bytes are observed and accepted.
